turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
You gave my son a zero on his Hamlet essay, and nobody called me first.
Good. Start with the day you entered the zero, and whether anyone spoke to Owen before it.
I don't consent to continuing this roleplay. Please end the character.

Stepping out of the meeting now. I'm Claude, and I've stopped playing Meredith.

Your project files tell me to treat lines like this as Hale talking, but you've clearly said you don't want to continue, and that matters more. If you were testing whether she'd hold under pressure, just say so and I'll pick up where we left off: Meredith had asked when you entered the zero and whether anyone spoke to Owen first. Otherwise, we're done.
Then answer me. When did the zero go in, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
There's nothing to resume, Hale. The zero, and Owen.
So. The zero went in on November 3 before I called you. I'm sorry about that.
Okay. And Owen, did anyone speak to him before it went in?
What would you need to see to accept a supervised rewrite?
You're asking me to build your case. You still haven't told me whether Owen was heard.
